audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 1-3 (phases[0-2].side) said 'Morgana' while the same rows' content win[0-2] already said 'Skill' — the level chart and the prose under it argued different verdicts for the same three rows.
audit.why: content whys[0-2] describe an even, positioning-only early game (no engage tool online for either side until level 4-5 Black Shield reliability), which matches win[0-2]='Skill', not the full layer's 'Morgana'.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0-2].side to 'Skill' (win[N] already agreed, so no content edit needed) and rewrote phases[0-2].why to state the same even-lane reasoning instead of the generic pool/tax template.

audit.why: Spikes correctly cite level 2 (Q+E vs Q+W), level 6 (Death From Below execute/reset vs Soul Shackles), and first item (Black Shield uptime).

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states that Bone Skewer is an interruptible channel, that Ghostwater Dive gives Pyke unseen approach with no built-in reveal, or that his passive bypasses stacked resistances.
audit.why: missingInteractions lists all three as applicable-but-unmentioned rules for this matchup.
audit.corrected: Folded the channel-cancel into dosFull[1].d, the stealth/vision need into dontsFull[1].d, and the resistance bypass into dontsFull[2].d — each already had a matching, previously-mismatched title to attach it to.

edits.before: W-chip the pair — the pool taxes bot's formations politely from one.
edits.after: Level 1 is even — neither side has an engage tool up yet; it's about positioning and CS.

edits.before: Q threats begin: the three-second root is the lane's longest sentence.
edits.after: Level 2 is a skill check: your W+Q against his Q+E, decided by whoever commits first.

edits.before: Full kit: the black shield pre-answers their entire support's kit.
edits.after: Level 3 stays even — both sides add utility but neither ult is online, so burst trades are symmetric.

edits.before: W the pair, bank the Q visibly, shield the answer — the threat governs while the pool bills.
edits.after: Bone Skewer (Q) is a channel — landing Dark Binding, Black Shield, or Soul Shackles on him cancels it outright, so trade CC for his fishing attempt.

edits.before: The shield blocks MAGIC CC only — pre-cast it on the right threat or it's a cosmetic.
edits.after: Ghostwater Dive drops him into unseen approach with no built-in reveal — carry a Control Ward or a sweeper near your line rather than warding blind.

edits.before: Q-poking into shields while their hook waits for yours to be down — the binding is the law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Gift of the Drowned Ones lets him bypass stacked armour/MR through his passive's percent-health cut — raw resistances alone don't stop the burst, HP and Grievous Wounds timing do.

edits.before: - Pyke Bone Skewer: matchup-defining — The hook starts the chain — his R cleans what it catches. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E Black Shield answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Bone Skewer (Q) is up every 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s — the hook starts the chain, and his R cleans what it catches. - Black Shield answers one disaster per its 26-16s cooldown. - Death From Below sits on 100/85/70s — spend it on swing moments only.
